clue.text: Reprimanded for having had the photo enlarged

definitions.meaning: someone reprimanded has been told off sharply, given a rocket
a print made bigger from its negative is a blow-up

explanation.surface: Someone got a dressing-down for having a picture enlarged.
explanation.definitionFit: Being angrily scolded and having a picture magnified are both idioms with the same two-word phrase.

clue.text: Confirm that the stock market is rising rapidly

definitions.meaning: to support or corroborate a claim

definitions.text: the stock market is rising rapidly
definitions.meaning: in a soaring market the pessimistic traders, bears, are out of the game

explanation.surface: Verify that share prices are shooting up.
explanation.definitionFit: To corroborate a statement is the idiom; in a boom the market's sellers are humorously absent.

clue.text: Dominican goes to a cathedral centre in little light

parts.note: OP, Order of Preachers, follows a Dominican friar's name
in Britain a city is traditionally a town with a cathedral

explanation.surface: A friar heads off to a cathedral town in the dim light.
explanation.walkthrough: OP stands for Ordo Praedicatorum, the Dominican order. 'centre' is not a middle-letter signal; a cathedral centre is a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Opacity is the quality of letting through hardly any light.

clue.text: Many a large zoo contains one

definitions.text: Many a large zoo contains one

indicators.note: the words many a large hold the answer within them

explanation.surface: Lots of big zoos keep this animal.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: nyala, a southern African antelope, kept in many large zoos.
explanation.definitionFit: A nyala is a spiral-horned African antelope, often exhibited in big wildlife parks.

clue.text: Explained how to indicate a wrong answer

definitions.text: how to indicate a wrong answer
definitions.meaning: a marker shows an error by drawing an X beside it

explanation.surface: A teacher told how to mark an incorrect answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Communicating something successfully is an idiom; marking an X is the literal phrase.

clue.text: Distemper is not easy to apply to one's studio

parts.note: something not easy is hard
a pad is slang for one's flat or studio apartment

explanation.surface: Applying whitewash paint to the walls of one's studio flat is tricky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Distemper' poses as the old wall paint but is the canine disease; hard pad is a form of distemper in dogs that hardens the paws.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard pad is a variety of the viral dog illness, named for its thickened paws.

clue.text: Useful abbreviations for Henry and Andrew

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, unit of inductance
Andy is the short form of Andrew

explanation.surface: Short forms for two men's names are helpful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abbreviations for' covers both: H is the scientific symbol for henry, Andy is a pet name for Andrew.
explanation.definitionFit: Something convenient and helpful is handy, a synonym.

clue.text: Punch needed by a discriminating angler

definitions.meaning: a boxing blow thrown with one arm
a fussy fisherman wants exactly the correct barb

explanation.surface: A blow thrown by a choosy fisherman.
explanation.definitionFit: A blow with one particular fist is a boxing term; the correct barb is literal.

clue.text: Strong wine supplied by one firm in the colonnade

parts.note: port is a fortified wine
I is the Roman numeral one
Co is short for company, a firm

explanation.surface: Fortified wine served by a company in a covered walkway.
explanation.definitionFit: A portico is a porch of columns, a kind of colonnade.

clue.text: Medic subsequently got a shire horse

parts.note: Dr is short for doctor
after means later, subsequently

explanation.surface: The doctor later acquired a heavy horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A shire horse is a heavy draught breed, so a drafter.

clue.text: A mother of industrious worker must be quite resolute

parts.note: a dam is an animal's mother
the ant is the proverbial hard worker

explanation.surface: A mother who works hard has to be firmly determined.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unshakeable in purpose is adamant, a synonym.

clue.text: Grain that is shortly to be produced in Africa

indicators.note: produced suggests the letters are made into something new, rearranged

parts.note: i.e. is the short form of 'that is'

explanation.surface: Grain is soon to be grown in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be produced' rearranges GRAIN plus IE. 'Shortly' looks like 'soon' but signals the abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: The definition names a country by its continent: a West African nation.

clue.text: Governing clique gives order to go charily

indicators.note: putting the letters in a new order means rearranging them

explanation.surface: A ruling group instructs people to proceed with caution.
explanation.definitionFit: Rule by a small powerful group is oligarchy, so a ruling clique is a synonym.

clue.text: It isn't commonly corrupt

parts.note: 't is the clipped form of it, as in 'twas
ain't is the colloquial form of isn't

explanation.surface: It is not, speaking colloquially, rotten.
explanation.walkthrough: Dialect 'tain't' means 'it isn't', built from 'T for it and AIN'T for isn't.
explanation.definitionFit: To spoil or contaminate something is to taint it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Go to a small street for secret assignation

parts.note: to have a go is to try
St is the abbreviation for street

explanation.surface: Head off down a little street for a clandestine meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A lovers' private rendezvous is a tryst, a synonym.

clue.text: I resented being made to pound the meat

indicators.note: the letters are fashioned into a new word, rearranged

explanation.surface: I was annoyed at being forced to beat the steak.
explanation.definitionFit: Beating meat to soften it is to tenderise it.

clue.text: Not too well disposed to a black-and-white TV

definitions.meaning: feeling slightly ill or below par
a monochrome set is literally one that is turned away from colour

explanation.surface: Feeling poorly and stuck with an old monochrome television set.
explanation.definitionFit: Slightly unwell is the idiom; a monochrome set is humorously one opposed to colour.

clue.text: As far as I'm concerned, it will create party disunity

parts.note: to form is to create

indicators.note: a party split apart has its letters scattered

explanation.surface: Personally, I think it will split the party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it will' only links; 'disunity' is the anagram signal, breaking up the second word, not a comment on politics.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking personally is the meaning of this idiom.

clue.text: Amorous fellow should be more prudent going round Arab sultanate

indicators.note: the wiser word encircles the sultanate's name

parts.note: more prudent is wiser
Oman is a sultanate on the Arabian peninsula

explanation.surface: A lovelorn man ought to be more careful when touring the Gulf.
explanation.definitionFit: A man who chases many women is a philanderer, a womaniser.

clue.text: Finished in a state of agitation

explanation.surface: Done and dusted, and highly stressed.
explanation.definitionFit: A meeting brought to an end is an idiom; a tense person is similarly described.

clue.text: Intending to reveal the significance

definitions.meaning: the sense or import of something

explanation.surface: Planning to disclose what it all signifies.
explanation.definitionFit: To intend is to mean, so intending is a participle; import is a noun sense.

clue.text: King and knight have to be recognised

parts.note: K is king in chess notation
N is knight in chess notation
to own is to have

explanation.surface: A monarch and his knight need to be acknowledged.
explanation.definitionFit: Something acknowledged or familiar is known, a synonym.

clue.text: Ham acquired by airman in public

indicators.note: the airman sits inside the word for public

parts.note: overt means open, public
AC is an aircraftman in the RAF

explanation.surface: Bacon picked up by a pilot in open view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ham' is not meat but a verb: to ham it up is to exaggerate on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A hammy actor exaggerates, so to ham is to perform too theatrically.

clue.text: Eccentric head is on trial

parts.note: nut is slang for head
a court case is a trial

explanation.surface: A crazy boss is standing trial.
explanation.definitionFit: A crank or oddball is a nutcase, slang synonym.

clue.text: Employment enables you and me to get on

parts.note: us is you and me together
to get on in years is to age

explanation.surface: A job helps the two of us get ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage means the use or employment of something, a synonym.

clue.text: Soon some consequence is apparent

parts.note: any can mean some, as in 'have you any?'
a matter of moment is one of consequence

explanation.surface: Some result is becoming obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: Something expected imminently will happen shortly, an adverbial idiom.

clue.text: In S America they run north-south as well as east-south

definitions.text: In S America they run north-south

parts.note: and means as well as
E and S are compass abbreviations for east and south

explanation.surface: The South American mountain ranges run lengthwise, also partly east to south.
explanation.definitionFit: A mountain chain along South America's west coast stretches from north to south.

clue.text: A brave appeal and wise

parts.note: O is an exclamation of appeal, as in 'O Lord'
sage means wise

explanation.surface: A courageous plea, and a wise one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brave' is a noun here: a Native American warrior; the Osage are a Plains people.
explanation.definitionFit: An Osage warrior is a Native American fighting man, called a brave.

clue.text: Accorded divine status, anyway

indicators.note: read as 'any way': the word is the same whichever direction it is read

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Made into a god, in any case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anyway' looks like a throwaway filler but splits as 'any way': the answer reads identically forwards and backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To be made a god is to be worshipped as divine, deification.

clue.text: Anglo-French articles written by graduates in the US

parts.note: A is the English indefinite article, LA the French definite one
A is the English indefinite article, LA the French definite one
BA and MA are Bachelor and Master of Arts degrees
BA and MA are Bachelor and Master of Arts degrees

explanation.surface: Essays in English and French written by American college graduates.
explanation.definitionFit: The definition locates a state within America: a southern state.

clue.text: The little swine

parts.note: read as an insult to a small rascal, but literally young pigs

explanation.definitionFit: Young pigs are the little ones of swine, so the small swine are their offspring.

clue.text: Framework for sending out letters

indicators.note: dispatching the letters scatters them into a new order

explanation.surface: A system for mailing correspondence.
explanation.definitionFit: A trestle is a supporting frame of a beam on legs, a framework.
